title: OBD Tire Pressure Seasonal Delta
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:pid metric=tire_pressure
| eval month=strftime(_time,"%m")
| stats avg(front_left_psi) as fl, avg(front_right_psi) as fr, avg(rear_left_psi) as rl, avg(rear_right_psi) as rr by vin month
| eval avg_psi=round((fl+fr+rl+rr)/4,1)
| eventstats max(avg_psi) as peak_psi, min(avg_psi) as trough_psi by vin
| eval seasonal_drop=round(peak_psi-trough_psi,1)
| where seasonal_drop>5
| sort - seasonal_drop
description: Uses OBD-II tire-pressure exports telemetry to monitor seasonal pressure spread across the year in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for vehicles that need more seasonal tire attention, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OBD-II tire-pressure exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges seasonal pressure spread across the year so you can spot vehicles that need more seasonal tire attention before it becomes annoying.
